# `aitbc contract messaging-reputation`

Show an address's messaging reputation (derived from sealed votes).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-reputation [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | yes | Sender address to look up reputation for |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-reputation --address <address>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract messaging-reputation --address <address> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
